description:
Implement the deferred-from-v0.3 auto-dispatch for oversized tool output (ARCH §3.3 last bullet, §11). Per §11 this lands 'alongside v0.4's subagent dispatch machinery' — Phase 6 because it depends on Phases 1-5 being green.

Scope:
- Sizing heuristic: a tool_result whose stdout (per-call output.json's stdout field) exceeds a configurable byte threshold is oversized. Default threshold pinned in this phase; a workflow.yaml knob is v0.6 work.
- Auto-dispatch: instead of feeding the raw oversized stdout to the parent step's next request, the harness automatically dispatches a parsing subagent (via Phase 2's primitive) with the raw output as its goal/input. Only the parsing subagent's compacted summary reaches the parent step as tool_result.content.
- The parent step's tool_result block is constructed from the parsing subagent's summary, NOT from the raw output.json. Per §3.3 this is application-layer assembly so the change is local to the request-assembly path.

Subtle pieces:
- The parser is a subagent dispatched and awaited synchronously inside the tool executor (the parent step's next-step request is not assembled until the parse completes — same pattern as terminal compaction).
- A new role is needed: 'parser' in souls/parser.md, declared in template/providers.yaml. Tools list for parser may be empty (it just consumes its goal text and returns a summary).
- The single-author-per-file discipline still holds: the parser writes only to its own worktree.

Out of scope:
- Sophisticated parsing (model-driven structured extraction). v0.4 ships the plumbing; the parser's soul is a stub-quality summarizer.
- User-configurable threshold (workflow.yaml integration is v0.6).
- Adversarial parser defense (§11 deferred).

Tests:
- A tool whose stdout exceeds the threshold triggers a parser subagent dispatch.
- The parser's compacted summary is what lands in the parent step's tool_result.content; the raw oversized stdout does not.
- An under-threshold tool result behaves identically to v0.3 (no auto-dispatch).
- The parser case is observable on disk: parser branch + worktree exist, parser's summary/<NNN>.md is the source of the parent's tool_result.content.

Done-when: oversized tool output automatically routes through a parser subagent; raw output never reaches the parent step when the threshold trips. §11 deferred-list updated by the docs gate to remove this entry.
title: v0.4 Phase 6: oversized tool-output auto-dispatch
